scholarships.title: Perimeter Scholars International (PSI) Master's Program - Full Scholarship

existing.description: The Perimeter Scholars International (PSI) programme is a one-year Master's in theoretical physics at the University of Waterloo, taught by Perimeter Institute faculty and visiting physicists, with coursework plus a supervised research essay. Perimeter's financial support page states that full scholarships are available to cover full tuition, accommodation, meals, a living stipend, health insurance, necessary IT equipment and learning materials, and a travel supplement. Consideration for a full scholarship is part of the admissions process rather than a separate application. The programme is funded by the Savvas Chamberlain Family Foundation, the Hellenic Heritage Foundation, the Marsland Family and members of the Emmy Noether Circle.
eligibility: Hold or be completing a bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in physics or a closely related field
Be a citizen of a country other than Canada
Demonstrate strong academic preparation in mathematics and physics
For applicants with other degrees, demonstrate understanding of classical mechanics, electromagnetism, special relativity, quantum mechanics and statistical physics
Be willing to study in person at Perimeter Institute in Waterloo, Ontario for the full academic year
Agree to consider other funding sources such as the NSERC Canada Graduate Research Scholarship - Master's, where eligible
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to applicants from outside Canada who hold, or are completing, a bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in physics, mathematics, astronomy or a related field, with a strong academic record. Students with other degrees may be considered in exceptional cases if they can demonstrate understanding of classical mechanics, electromagnetism, special relativity, quantum mechanics and statistical physics.
benefits: Full tuition paid for the PSI programme
Necessary IT equipment and learning materials
Access to senior student and academic staff mentors, wellness initiatives and mental health support
Eligibility to be considered for Perimeter's PhD Residency Program Award progression route
coverage: Necessary IT equipment and learning materials
requirements: Complete the PSI online application before the published deadline
Provide academic transcripts and evidence of degree completion or expected completion
Supply references as required by the application form
Canadian PSI applicants should apply to the NSERC Canada Graduate Research Scholarship - Master's before December 1 and discuss the outcome with Perimeter
PSI students are expected to apply for any non-PSI scholarship funding for which they may be eligible
documents: Degree certificate or proof of expected completion
Reference information as requested in the application form
Language evidence where the application requires it
application_method: Apply online through the Perimeter Institute PSI application form
Submit before Sunday January 24, 2027 at 11:59 pm ET
Attend a short oral interview if contacted
If admitted and offered a scholarship, confirm acceptance and the start of the academic year in Waterloo
existing.selection_notes: Consideration for a full scholarship is part of the PSI admissions process. Perimeter states it is committed to diversity within its community and especially welcomes applications from racialized persons, women, Indigenous or Aboriginal People of North America, persons with disabilities and LGBTQ2+ persons, and provides support and accommodations throughout the application and interview process for applicants with disabilities.
existing.best_fit: Physics, mathematics or astronomy undergraduates or graduates from outside Canada who want a fully funded one-year theoretical physics master's in a research environment and are prepared to commit to the full in-person year.
existing.notes: Perimeter publishes no cash figure for the full scholarship, stating only that the provisions 'have no cash value and are provided as-is', so funding_amount is null. Canadian applicants are asked to seek NSERC CGSM funding, and if successful a portion is applied to the PSI programme cost, so full scholarship amounts for Canadian applicants may differ.
existing.duration: One year (one academic year) of full-time master's study
existing.application_period: Applications are open with a published submission deadline of Sunday January 24, 2027 at 11:59 pm ET. There is no application fee. Selected candidates may be contacted for a short oral interview.
